title: NearInch
tagline: A platform for cross chain swap that uses one inch fusion plus for near
description: This project was built as a bridge to one inch fusion plus for near, It was made using near contracts and using cross-shain-swap sdk, This was made by near contracts that were written in rust and the resolver part was made using typescript. It enables cross chain transaction using near and ethereum
how_its_made: It serves as two layer one for near contracts and other for near the resolver which listen to both chain for transaction and all, This project was built as a bridge to one inch fusion plus for near, It was made using near contracts and using cross-shain-swap sdk, This was made by near contracts that were written in rust and the resolver part was made using typescript
